notes.title: Demo Update v2.0.0
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone![/p][p][/p][p]I am pleased to announce the Demo v2.0.0 is out! We have been working very hard to release the full game for all of you to enjoy, and we can say that we will finally release the game in a few months. With the new demo release, you guys will be able to see how the actual game is going to look like (which is A LOT of differences comparing with Demo v1.0.0. Here's some major points:

1. Enhanced graphics[/p][p]The game now utilizes a completely new shader and models, which are a lot more appealing to the previous versions.[/p][p][/p][p]The UIs are also completely redesigned, improving user experience when navigating through menus.[/p][p][/p][p]2. Improved Audio[/p][p]The audio are also changed in this major update. All of the screens now has a different music. There are also music for different levels. Character voices, sound effects are also updated.[/p][p][/p][p]3. Cutscene Inclusion[/p][p]Cutscenes have been added to the game, adding a layer of storytelling in the game.[/p][p][/p][p]4. Map Update[/p][p]A whole new map is designed for the game. The map has different areas, giving out different challenges to players.[/p][p][/p][p]5. Player Update[/p][p]Player breathes by holding and releasing the key "W" instead of simply tapping it. Player also now walks in accordance to how much energy the player has.[/p][p][/p][p]These are just the major points covering the update, since I don't wanna sound like a nerdddd, I'm just gonna skip the technical stuff. Well, enjoy the game~ :D[/p][p][/p][p]Cheers,[/p][p]Circo
We Don't Have A Studio[/p]
